scope: read-only local database probes for M8; no PL/SQL was compiled or changed

m8.synonymSource: authored source plus structural parser; qualification uses ALL_PROCEDURES, ALL_ARGUMENTS, and PL/Scope restricted to the frozen (OWNER, OBJECT_NAME) inventory
m8.currentSchema: CURRENT_SCHEMA resolves unqualified names at compile time; the adapter records the manifest/default schema as the owner segment and preserves explicit qualifiers
m8.synonymExpansion: none in production facts or binding keys; synonym targets are not dereferenced
m8.caseFolding: unquoted identifiers use canonical uppercase; quoted identifiers preserve authored spelling; query comparison uppercases unquoted input and preserves quoted input
m8.evidence: NLS_COMP and NLS_SORT are BINARY; no owned synonyms exist in the local database

m9.grouping: flat occurrence list; no grouping by symbol or owner
m9.ordering: path, start offset, role, symbol ID, then remaining occurrence-key fields
m9.pagination: generation-bound keyset cursor over the ordering tuple plus a filter digest
m9.ownerSummary: each occurrence carries its stored owner summary or null
